title: Harden admin gating, add hacker-themed admin UI, and improve admin order operations

requirements.summary: Harden admin detection and gating to eliminate flicker, stale state, and delayed admin affordances; add reliable admin entry redirect behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user logs in as an admin, the header renders an admin affordance (e.g., Admin link/button) as soon as the admin check completes, and does not remain hidden due to stale/undefined state.
AdminGate shows a clear loading state while checking admin status and does not briefly show Access Denied for an actual admin.
If the user is authenticated and confirmed admin, navigating to / redirects them to /admin (or an equivalent immediate admin entry flow) without requiring manual refresh.
If the user is not an admin, /admin reliably shows Access Denied (and never shows admin data).

file_operations.description: Make admin-check state deterministic by aligning React Query loading/fetched flags with actor/identity readiness (avoid returning false while permissions are still being determined); keep calling the backend capability isCallerAdmin and handle errors consistently.

Update gating logic to use the hardened admin-check state (loading vs resolved) so it shows a clear loading view during checks and never flashes Access Denied for real admins; ensure it reliably blocks non-admins.

Ensure the Admin link/button behavior is stable: show it immediately after admin status resolves true; avoid flicker/missing admin affordance due to undefined/stale admin state; optionally render a disabled/placeholder admin affordance while admin status is being checked for authenticated users.

Adjust the index (/) routing behavior so authenticated confirmed admins are immediately routed into the admin entry flow (/admin) after the admin check completes, while non-admin authenticated users go to the dashboard; preserve existing AuthGate/AdminGate protections for /admin.

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only order deletion workflow in the admin UI with confirmation and immediate list refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only method to delete an order by orderId; deleting a non-existent order returns a clear error.
Admin Panel UI includes a per-order Delete/Cancel action with a confirmation dialog.
After deletion, the order disappears from the admin orders list without requiring a full page refresh (React Query cache invalidation/refetch works).
Non-admins cannot delete orders (frontend hides controls; backend rejects calls).

file_operations.description: Create a React Query mutation hook that calls the backend capability to delete an order and invalidates admin/user order queries to refresh UI immediately.

Add a per-order Delete/Cancel action that opens a confirmation dialog and triggers the delete mutation; disable controls during in-flight deletion and show success/error feedback; ensure list updates via query invalidation without full refresh.
If needed, refine/extend query keys to ensure consistent invalidation for admin list + any related order detail/user order queries after deletion.

requirements.summary: Align 'Reset All Data' in the admin UI with the real backend reset behavior and keep confirmations/loading states correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel 'Reset All Data' triggers a backend admin-only reset that clears persisted order data in the canister (not only localStorage).
After reset, getAllOrders() returns an empty list and the UI shows the 'No Orders' state.
The reset action still uses a confirmation dialog and shows pending/loading state while running.
Non-admin callers cannot invoke reset; backend enforces authorization.

file_operations.description: Replace the current local-only reset with a call to the backend capability resetAllData; keep local cleanup (e.g., user_orders_* keys) but ensure the backend reset runs; keep robust invalidation for all order/admin-related queries.

Keep the existing confirmation dialog but ensure copy, pending state, and result handling match the true behavior (backend reset + UI refresh to 'No Orders'); prevent double-submit while resetting and show actionable errors.

requirements.summary: Implement a distinct hacker/cyber admin theme for /admin routes and admin-only components without modifying Shadcn component sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin routes render with a clearly distinct visual style (e.g., terminal/cyber aesthetic) while non-admin pages keep the existing site theme.
Theming is implemented without modifying immutable Shadcn component sources; styling is applied via composition, Tailwind classes, and/or CSS variables at the page/layout level.
Admin theme remains readable and accessible (sufficient contrast for primary text and controls).

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight wrapper/layout that applies an admin-only theme scope (e.g., a root class for CSS variable overrides + background effects) for /admin screens; compose existing components instead of modifying Shadcn sources.

Add a scoped admin theme (e.g., .admin-theme) using CSS variables and/or utility-friendly base styles to create a terminal/cyber aesthetic while keeping contrast/readability; ensure non-admin theme remains unchanged.
Wrap the /admin route content with AdminThemeLayout so the hacker theme is applied consistently across admin screens and admin-only components.
Adjust admin page composition/classes where needed so the new admin theme looks cohesive across cards, headers, controls, and empty states without editing files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.summary: Add advanced admin panel controls (search/filter/sort, quick actions, and order insights) without changing the customer ordering flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can filter orders by status (pending/approved/shipped) and search by name, order ID, or ID number.
Admin can sort orders at least by creation time (newest/oldest).
Admin has one-click quick actions per order for common status transitions (e.g., Approve, Mark Shipped) with clear success/error feedback.
Admin panel shows basic summary stats (e.g., counts by status) that update when data changes.
All new admin controls are disabled appropriately during in-flight mutations to prevent double-submits.

file_operations.description: Add UI + derived client-side logic for search (name/order ID/ID number), status filter, and sort (creation time newest/oldest); add summary stats (counts by status) that update based on the displayed dataset; add one-click quick action buttons per order for common status transitions using existing mutation hooks; ensure all controls disable appropriately during in-flight mutations and show clear feedback.
If needed, add small, reusable formatting helpers for admin insights (e.g., time display) used by AdminPanelPage while keeping user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Stabilize admin flow and order management UI with better loading/error handling, consistent invalidation, and safe handling of missing values.
acceptanceCriteria: All admin mutations (status update, tracking save, delete, reset) surface actionable error messages and do not leave the UI in a stuck loading state.
React Query cache invalidation is consistent so lists/details stay in sync after admin actions.
Unauthorized backend calls trap with clear messages and do not expose data.
Admin UI handles empty states and null/undefined values (e.g., trackingNumber) without console errors.

file_operations.description: Improve resilience for admin order loading: ensure query enablement aligns with actor readiness, handle and surface errors cleanly (including unauthorized), and avoid console errors on transient states.
Ensure consistent query invalidation and robust error propagation for status updates so admin list and any user/order views remain in sync after mutations.
Harden tracking save mutation behavior: consistent invalidation, clear error propagation, and ensure UI can safely handle missing trackingNumber values without crashes.
Ensure reset mutation never leaves UI stuck: propagate errors, invalidate all relevant queries consistently, and keep local cleanup aligned with backend reset behavior.

Add focused UI stability improvements: show clear loading/error/empty states, prevent double-submits across all mutations (status, tracking, delete, reset), and ensure null/undefined values render safely without console errors.
Ensure unauthorized state is stable and never leaks admin data; keep a clear loading state during permission checks and handle failed admin checks gracefully.
